items.title: CMU opens robotics facilities to IROS 2026 attendees
items.summary_en: According to search-result snippets of the CMU and RI pages, hundreds of academic and industry robotics attendees of IROS 2026 (held in Pittsburgh) toured CMU facilities on Oct. 1, including the Robotics Innovation Center, Mill 19 and the National Robotics Engineering Center. The story presents CMU's robotics ecosystem as a draw for the conference.
items.notes: Article not fetched (DNS failure); from search snippets. Same story at https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-robotics-expertise-and-facilities-attract-iros-2026-conference-attendees. Press release, not peer-reviewed.
